svg.title: Sign in
svg.desc: The browser posts the login to the API, which finds the user in Postgres; with the right password the API returns a session, and otherwise refuses with a 401. Sign in: 1. Browser calls API: POST /login. Check the password: 2. API calls Users: find user. 3. Users replies to API: user. If password matches: 4a. API replies to Browser: session. Otherwise: 4b. API replies to Browser: 401, refused.
